# Step - import_graphson

`import_graphson` · category: [Graph information and files](../../traversal/step_reference.md#graph-information-and-files)

Imports a GraphSON file into the graph as one unit (needs file access).

## Forms

```text
import_graphson(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai
g.import_graphson("modern.json")
```

- [GraphSON](../../users_guide/graphson.md)
